title: Reckoning the Default Rebill of Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)
content:
**Billing standard — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements): the balance billed back at a default**

**Unbilled balance.** The unbilled balance is the amount moved into the agreement less every installment billed and every amount already billed back, as the agreement's ledger records them.

**Latest bill.** The latest bill is the bill of the latest installment's billing period, that is, the billing period of the most recent installment-billed entry on the agreement's ledger.

**Credits.** No credit standing on the service account is applied to the balance billed back: neither a credit balance carried into the latest bill nor any bill credit posted on the latest bill.

**Balance billed back.** The balance billed back at the default is the unbilled balance less the credits applied to it, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end. It is due the tier's rebill due days after the default date, a figure of 0 meaning that it is due on issue.

**Worked figure (hypothetical agreement)**

| Agreement ledger | Amount |
|---|---|
| moved into the agreement | $900.00 |
| installments billed: $150.00, $150.00 | $300.00 |
| already billed back | $0.00 |
| unbilled balance | $600.00 |
| credit applied | $0.00 |
| balance billed back | $600.00 |

**Due date (hypothetical default on May 12)**

| Tier's rebill due days | Balance billed back due |
|---|---|
| 0 | on issue, May 12 |
| 10 | May 22 |
